title: URL Encoder & Decoder
h1: URL Encoder & Decoder — Encode and Decode URLs
seoTitle: URL Encoder Decoder — Free Online Percent Encoder
description: Encode or decode URLs and query strings with percent-encoding. Handles spaces, special characters and full URLs. Runs privately in your browser.
intro: Paste a URL or text and encode it for safe use in a link, or decode a percent-encoded string back to readable text. Everything stays on your device.
blurb: Percent-encode or decode URLs and query values instantly — free and private.
howItWorks: Paste a URL, query string or plain text.
Click Encode to apply percent-encoding or Decode to reverse it.
The result appears immediately. Processing is local.
examples: Encode a search term that contains spaces or punctuation.
Decode a long tracking URL to read its parameters.
Prepare a redirect URL that must be safely embedded.

faq.q: Is the whole URL encoded or just the query?
faq.a: The tool encodes the entire input. For a full URL you usually want encodeURIComponent on individual parameter values.
Yes. Non-ASCII characters are correctly percent-encoded using UTF-8.
